items.title: MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM is Now Generally Available
items.summary: The MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM is now generally available, giving Java teams a production-ready way to use familiar Hibernate APIs with MongoDB’s document model. It is a first-party, open-source library that enables Java applications to use MongoDB as the backing database via the Hibernate ORM. The extension allows Java developers to enjoy the same experience with MongoDB, reducing the friction for those who want to switch.
